verses.en: YAHUAH, who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets,
verses.am: ከጥንት ጀምሮ እግዚአብሔር በብዙ ዓይነትና በብዙ ጎዳና ለአባቶቻችን በነቢያት ተናግሮ፥

verses.en: Hath in these last days spoken unto us by his Son, whom he hath appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the worlds;
verses.am: ሁሉን ወራሽ ባደረገው ደግሞም ዓለማትን በፈጠረበት በልጁ በዚህ ዘመን መጨረሻ ለእኛ ተናገረን፤

verses.en: Who being the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;
verses.am: እርሱም የክብሩ መንጸባረቅና የባሕርዩ ምሳሌ ሆኖ፥ ሁሉን በስልጣኑ ቃል እየደገፈ፥ ኃጢአታችንን በራሱ ካነጻ በኋላ በሰማያት በግርማው ቀኝ ተቀመጠ፤

verses.en: Being made so much better than the angels, as he hath by inheritance obtained a more excellent name than they.
verses.am: ከመላእክት ይልቅ እጅግ የሚበልጥ ስምን በወረሰ መጠን እንዲሁ ከእነርሱ አብዝቶ ይበልጣል።

verses.en: For unto which of the angels said he at any time, Thou art my Son, this day have I begotten thee? And again, I will be to him a Father, and he shall be to me a Son?
verses.am: ከመላእክትስ። አንተ ልጄ ነህ፥ እኔ ዛሬ ወልጄሃለሁ፥ ደግሞም። እኔ አባት እሆነዋለሁ እርሱም ልጅ ይሆነኛል

verses.en: And again, when he bringeth in the firstbegotten into the world, he saith, And let all the angels of YAHUAH worship him.
verses.am: ያለው ከቶ ለማን ነው? ደግሞም በኵርን ወደ ዓለም ሲያገባ። የእግዚአብሔር መላእክት ሁሉም ለእርሱ ይስገዱ ይላል።

verses.en: And of the angels he saith, Who maketh his angels spirits, and his ministers a flame of fire.
verses.am: ስለ መላእክትም። መላእክቱን መናፍስት አገልጋዮቹንም የእሳት ነበልባል የሚያደርግ

verses.en: But unto the Son he saith, Thy throne, O YAHUAH, is for ever and ever: a sceptre of righteousness is the sceptre of thy kingdom.
verses.am: ይላል፤ ስለ ልጁ ግን። አምላክ ሆይ፥ ዙፋንህ እስከ ዘላለም ድረስ ይኖራል፤ የመንግሥትህ በትር የቅንነት በትር ነው።

verses.en: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated iniquity; therefore YAHUAH, even thy YAHUAH, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.
verses.am: ጽድቅን ወደድህ ዓመፅንም ጠላህ፤ ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር አምላክህ ከጓደኞችህ ይልቅ በደስታ ዘይት ቀባህ

verses.en: And, Thou, Master, in the beginning hast laid the foundation of the earth; and the heavens are the works of thine hands:
verses.am: ይላል። ደግሞ። ጌታ ሆይ፥ አንተ ከጥንት ምድርን መሠረትህ፥ ሰማዮችም የእጆችህ ሥራ ናቸው፤

verses.en: They shall perish; but thou remainest; and they all shall wax old as doth a garment;
verses.am: እነርሱም ይጠፋሉ አንተ ግን ጸንተህ ትኖራለህ፤ ሁሉም እንደ ልብስ ያረጃሉ፥

verses.en: And as a vesture shalt thou fold them up, and they shall be changed: but thou art the same, and thy years shall not fail.
verses.am: እንደ መጎናጸፊያም ትጠቀልላቸዋለህ ይለወጡማል፤ አንተ ግን አንተ ነህ፥ ዓመቶችህም ከቶ አያልቁም

verses.en: But to which of the angels said he at any time, Sit on my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool?
verses.am: ይላል። ነገር ግን ከመላእክት። ጠላቶችህን የእግርህ መረገጫ እስካደርግልህ ድረስ በቀኜ ተቀመጥ

verses.en: Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?
verses.am: ከቶ ለማን ብሎአል? ሁሉ መዳንን ይወርሱ ዘንድ ስላላቸው ለማገዝ የሚላኩ የሚያገለግሉም መናፍስት አይደሉምን?

verses.en: Therefore we ought to give the more earnest heed to the things which we have heard, lest at any time we should let them slip.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ከሰማነው ነገር ምናልባት እንዳንወሰድ፥ ለእርሱ አብልጠን ልንጠነቀቅ ያስፈልገናል።

verses.en: For if the word spoken by angels was stedfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompence of reward;
verses.am: በመላእክት የተነገረው ቃል ጽኑ ከሆነ፥ መተላለፍና አለመታዘዝም ሁሉ የጽድቅን ብድራት ከተቀበለ፥ እኛስ እንዲህ ያለውን ታላቅ መዳን ቸል ብንለው፥ እንዴት እናመልጣለን?

verses.en: How shall we escape, if we neglect so great salvation; which at the first began to be spoken by the Master, and was confirmed unto us by them that heard him;
verses.am: ይህ በጌታ በመጀመሪያ የተነገረ ነበርና፥ የሰሙትም ለእኛ አጸኑት፥

verses.en: YAHUAH also bearing them witness, both with signs and wonders, and with divers miracles, and gifts of the Set-apart Spirit, according to his own will?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም እርሱ ራሱ እንደ ፈቀደ በምልክትና በድንቅ ነገር በልዩ ልዩ ተአምራትም፥ መንፈስ ቅዱስንም በማደል አብሮ መሰከረለት።

verses.en: For unto the angels hath he not put in subjection the world to come, whereof we speak.
verses.am: ስለ እርሱ የምንናገርበትን የሚመጣውን ዓለም ለመላእክት ያስገዛው አይደለምና።

verses.en: But one in a certain place testified, saying, What is man, that thou art mindful of him? or the son of man, that thou visitest him?
verses.am: ነገር ግን አንዱ በአንድ ስፍራ። ታስበው ዘንድ ሰው ምንድር ነው? ወይስ ትጎበኘው ዘንድ የሰው ልጅ ምንድር ነው?

verses.en: Thou madest him a little lower than the angels; thou crownedst him with glory and honour, and didst set him over the works of thy hands:
verses.am: ከመላእክት ይልቅ በጥቂት አሳነስኸው፤ የክብርና የምስጋና ዘውድ ጫንህለት፥ በእጆችህም ሥራ ላይ ሾምኸው፤

verses.en: Thou hast put all things in subjection under his feet. For in that he put all in subjection under him, he left nothing that is not put under him. But now we see not yet all things put under him.
verses.am: ሁሉን ከእግሮቹ በታች አስገዛህለት ብሎ መሰከረ። ሁሉን ከእርሱ በታች ባስገዛ ጊዜ ያልተገዛለት ምንም አልተወምና። አሁን ግን ሁሉ እንደ ተገዛለት ገና አናይም፤

verses.en: But we see Yahushua, who was made a little lower than the angels for the suffering of death, crowned with glory and honour; that he by the grace of YAHUAH should taste death for every man.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በእግዚአብሔር ጸጋ ስለ ሰው ሁሉ ሞትን ይቀምስ ዘንድ፥ ከመላእክት ይልቅ በጥቂት አንሶ የነበረውን ኢየሱስን ከሞት መከራ የተነሣ የክብርና የምስጋናን ዘውድ ተጭኖ እናየዋለን።

verses.en: For it became him, for whom are all things, and by whom are all things, in bringing many sons unto glory, to make the captain of their salvation perfect through sufferings.
verses.am: ብዙ ልጆችን ወደ ክብር ሲያመጣ የመዳናቸውን ራስ በመከራ ይፈጽም ዘንድ፥ ከእርሱ የተነሣ ሁሉ በእርሱም ሁሉ ለሆነ፥ ለእርሱ ተገብቶታልና።

verses.en: For both he that sanctifieth and they who are sanctified are all of one: for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brethren,
verses.am: ስለዚህም ምክንያት። ስምህን ለወንድሞቼ እነግራቸዋለሁ በማኅበርም መካከል በዜማ አመሰግንሃለሁ፤ ደግሞም። እኔ በእርሱ እታመናለሁ፤ ደግሞም። እነሆኝ እኔን እግዚአብሔር የሰጠኝንም ልጆች ሲል ወንድሞች ብሎ ሊጠራቸው አያፍርም።

verses.en: Saying, I will declare thy name unto my brethren, in the midst of the assembly will I sing praise unto thee.
verses.am: ስለዚህም ምክንያት። ስምህን ለወንድሞቼ እነግራቸዋለሁ በማኅበርም መካከል በዜማ አመሰግንሃለሁ፤ ደግሞም። እኔ በእርሱ እታመናለሁ፤ ደግሞም። እነሆኝ እኔን እግዚአብሔር የሰጠኝንም ልጆች ሲል ወንድሞች ብሎ ሊጠራቸው አያፍርም።

verses.en: And again, I will put my trust in him. And again, Behold I and the children which YAHUAH hath given me.
verses.am: የአብርሃምን ዘር ይዞአል እንጂ የያዘው የመላእክትን አይደለም።

verses.en: Forasmuch then as the children are partakers of flesh and blood, he also himself likewise took part of the same; that through death he might destroy him that had the power of death, that is, the devil;
verses.am: የአብርሃምን ዘር ይዞአል እንጂ የያዘው የመላእክትን አይደለም።

verses.en: And deliver them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.
verses.am: ስለዚህ የሕዝብን ኃጢአት ለማስተስረይ፥ ለእግዚአብሔር በሆነው ነገር ሁሉ የሚምርና የታመነ ሊቀ ካህናት እንዲሆን፥ በነገር ሁሉ ወንድሞቹን ሊመስል ተገባው።

verses.en: For verily he took not on him the nature of angels; but he took on him the seed of Abraham.
verses.am: እርሱ ራሱ ተፈትኖ መከራን ስለ ተቀበለ የሚፈተኑትን ሊረዳቸው ይችላልና።

verses.en: Wherefore in all things it behoved him to be made like unto his brethren, that he might be a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to YAHUAH, to make reconciliation for the sins of the people.
For in that he himself hath suffered being tempted, he is able to succour them that are tempted.
Wherefore, holy brethren, partakers of the heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our profession, the Messiah Yahushua;
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ ከሰማያዊው ጥሪ ተካፋዮች የሆናችሁ ቅዱሳን ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ የሃይማኖታችንን ሐዋርያና ሊቀ ካህናት ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስን ተመልከቱ፤

verses.en: Who was faithful to him that appointed him, as also Mosheh was faithful in all his house.
verses.am: ሙሴ ደግሞ በቤቱ ሁሉ የታመነ እንደሆነ፥ እርሱ ለሾመው የታመነ ነበረ።

verses.en: For this man was counted worthy of more glory than Mosheh, inasmuch as he who hath builded the house hath more honour than the house.
verses.am: ቤትን የሚያዘጋጀው ከቤቱ ይልቅ የሚበልጥ ክብር እንዳለው መጠን፥ እንዲሁ እርሱ ከሙሴ ይልቅ የሚበልጥ ክብር የተገባው ሆኖ ተቆጥሮአልና።

verses.en: For every house is builded by some man; but he that built all things is YAHUAH.
verses.am: እያንዳንዱ ቤት በአንድ ሰው ተዘጋጅቶአልና፥ ሁሉን ያዘጋጀ ግን እግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.en: And Mosheh verily was faithful in all his house, as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were to be spoken after;
verses.am: ሙሴስ በኋላ ስለሚነገረው ነገር ምስክር ሊሆን በቤቱ ሁሉ እንደ ሎሌ የታመነ ነበረ፥ ክርስቶስ ግን እንደ ልጅ በቤቱ ላይ የታመነ ነው፤

verses.en: But Messiah as a son over his own house; whose house are we, if we hold fast the confidence and the rejoicing of the hope firm unto the end.
verses.am: እኛም የምንደፍርበትን የምንመካበትንም ተስፋ እስከ መጨረሻው አጽንተን ብንጠብቅ ቤቱ ነን።

verses.en: Wherefore (as the Set-apart Spirit saith, To day if ye will hear his voice,
verses.am: ስለዚህ መንፈስ ቅዱስ እንደሚል።

verses.en: Harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, in the day of temptation in the wilderness:
When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my works forty years.
verses.am: ዛሬ ድምፁን ብትሰሙት፥ አባቶቻችሁ እኔን የፈተኑበት የመረመሩበትም አርባ ዓመትም ሥራዬን ያዩበት በምድረ በዳ በፈተና ቀን በማስመረር እንደ ሆነ፥ ልባችሁን እልከኛ አታድርጉ።

verses.en: Wherefore I was grieved with that generation, and said, They do alway err in their heart; and they have not known my ways.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ያን ትውልድ ተቆጥቼ። ዘወትር በልባቸው ይስታሉ መንገዴን ግን አላወቁም አልሁ፤

verses.en: So I sware in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest.)
verses.am: እንዲሁ። ወደ ዕረፍቴ አይገቡም ብዬ በቍጣዬ ማልሁ።

verses.en: Take heed, brethren, lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief, in departing from the living YAHUAH.
verses.am: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ምናልባት ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን የሚያስክዳችሁ ክፉና የማያምን ልብ ከእናንተ በአንዳችሁ እንዳይኖር ተጠንቀቁ፤

verses.en: But exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከእናንተ ማንም በኃጢአት መታለል እልከኛ እንዳይሆን፥ ዛሬ ተብሎ ሲጠራ ሳለ፥ በእያንዳንዱ ቀን እርስ በርሳችሁ ተመካከሩ፤

verses.en: For we are made partakers of Messiah, if we hold the beginning of our confidence stedfast unto the end;
verses.am: የመጀመሪያ እምነታችንን እስከ መጨረሻው አጽንተን ብንጠብቅ፥ የክርስቶስ ተካፋዮች ሆነናልና፤

verses.en: While it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation.
verses.am: እየተባለ። ዛሬ ድምጹን ብትሰሙት፥ በማስመረር እንደሆነ ልባችሁን እልከኛ አታድርጉ።

verses.en: For some, when they had heard, did provoke: howbeit not all that came out of Mitsrayim by Mosheh.
verses.am: ሰምተው ያስመረሩት እነማን ነበሩ? በሙሴ ተመርተው ከግብጽ የወጡ ሁሉ አይደሉምን?

verses.en: But with whom was he grieved forty years? was it not with them that had sinned, whose carcases fell in the wilderness?
verses.am: አርባ አመትም የተቆጣባቸው እነማን ነበሩ? ሬሳቸው በምድረ በዳ የወደቀ፥ ኃጢአትን ያደረጉት እነርሱ አይደሉምን?

verses.en: And to whom sware he that they should not enter into his rest, but to them that believed not?
verses.am: ካልታዘዙትም በቀር ወደ እረፍቱ እንዳይገቡ የማለባቸው እነማን ነበሩ?

verses.en: So we see that they could not enter in because of unbelief.
verses.am: ባለማመናቸውም ጠንቅ ሊገቡ እንዳልተቻላቸው እናያለን።

verses.en: Let us therefore fear, lest, a promise being left us of entering into his rest, any of you should seem to come short of it.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ወደ ዕረፍቱ ለመግባት ተስፋ ገና ቀርቶልን ከሆነ፥ ምናልባት ከእናንተ ማንም የማይበቃ መስሎ እንዳይታይ እንፍራ።

verses.en: For unto us was the gospel preached, as well as unto them: but the word preached did not profit them, not being mixed with faith in them that heard it.
verses.am: ለእነዚያ ደግሞ እንደ ተነገረ ለእኛ የምስራች ተሰብኮልናልና፤ ዳሩ ግን የሰሙት ቃል ከሰሚዎቹ ጋር በእምነት ስላልተዋሐደ አልጠቀማቸውም።

verses.en: For we which have believed do enter into rest, as he said, As I have sworn in my wrath, if they shall enter into my rest: although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.
verses.am: ሥራው ዓለም ከተፈጠረ ጀምሮ ምንም እንኳ ቢፈጸም። እንዲህ። ወደ ዕረፍቴ አይገቡም ብዬ በቁጣዬ ማልሁ እንዳለ፥ እኛስ ያመንን ወደ ዕረፍቱ እንገባለን።

verses.en: For he spake in a certain place of the seventh day on this wise, And YAHUAH did rest the seventh day from all his works.
verses.am: ስለ ሰባተኛው ቀን በአንድ ስፍራ። እግዚአብሔርም በሰባተኛው ቀን ከሥራው ሁሉ ዐረፈ ብሎአልና፤

verses.en: And in this place again, If they shall enter into my rest.
verses.am: በዚህ ስፍራም ደግሞ። ወደ ዕረፍቴ አይገቡም።

verses.en: Seeing therefore it remaineth that some must enter therein, and they to whom it was first preached entered not in because of unbelief:
verses.am: እንግዲህ አንዳንዶች በዚያ እንዲገቡ ስለ ቀሩ፥ ቀድሞም የምስራች የተሰበከላቸው ባለመታዘዝ ጠንቅ ስላልገቡ።

verses.en: Again, he limiteth a certain day, saying in Dawid, To day, after so long a time; as it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts.
verses.am: ዛሬ ድምፁን ብትሰሙት ልባችሁን እልከኛ አታድርጉ በፊት እንደ ተባለ፥ ይህን ከሚያህል ዘመን በኋላ በዳዊት ሲናገር። ዛሬ ብሎ አንድ ቀን እንደ ገና ይቀጥራል።

verses.en: For if Yahushua had given them rest, then would he not afterward have spoken of another day.
verses.am: ኢያሱ አሳርፎአቸው ኖሮ ቢሆንስ፥ ከዚያ በኋላ ስለ ሌላ ቀን ባልተናገረ ነበር።

verses.en: There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of YAHUAH.
verses.am: እንግዲያስ የሰንበት ዕረፍት ለእግዚአብሔር ሕዝብ ቀርቶላቸዋል።

verses.en: For he that is entered into his rest, he also hath ceased from his own works, as YAHUAH did from his.
verses.am: ወደ ዕረፍቱ የገባ፥ እግዚአብሔር ከሥራው እንዳረፈ፥ እርሱ ደግሞ ከሥራው አርፎአልና።

verses.en: Let us labour therefore to enter into that rest, lest any man fall after the same example of unbelief.
verses.am: እንግዲህ እንደዚያ እንደ አለመታዘዝ ምሳሌ ማንም እንዳይወድቅ ወደዚያ ዕረፍት ለመግባት እንትጋ።

verses.en: For the word of YAHUAH is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ሕያው ነውና፥ የሚሠራም፥ ሁለትም አፍ ካለው ሰይፍ ሁሉ ይልቅ የተሳለ ነው፥ ነፍስንና መንፈስንም ጅማትንና ቅልጥምንም እስኪለይ ድረስ ይወጋል፥ የልብንም ስሜትና አሳብ ይመረምራል፤

verses.en: Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do.
verses.am: እኛን በሚቆጣጠር በእርሱ ዓይኖቹ ፊት ሁሉ ነገር የተራቆተና የተገለጠ ነው እንጂ፥ በእርሱ ፊት የተሰወረ ፍጥረት የለም።

verses.en: Seeing then that we have a great high priest, that is passed into the heavens, Yahushua the Son of YAHUAH, let us hold fast our profession.
verses.am: እንግዲህ በሰማያት ያለፈ ትልቅ ሊቀ ካህናት የእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ኢየሱስ ስላለን፥ ጸንተን ሃይማኖታችንን እንጠብቅ።

verses.en: For we have not an high priest which cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but was in all points tempted like as we are, yet without sin.
verses.am: ከኃጢአት በቀር በነገር ሁሉ እንደ እኛ የተፈተነ ነው እንጂ፥ በድካማችን ሊራራልን የማይችል ሊቀ ካህናት የለንም።

verses.en: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ምሕረትን እንድንቀበል በሚያስፈልገንም ጊዜ የሚረዳንን ጸጋ እንድናገኝ ወደ ጸጋው ዙፋን በእምነት እንቅረብ።

verses.en: For every high priest taken from among men is ordained for men in things pertaining to YAHUAH, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins:
verses.am: ሊቀ ካህናት ሁሉ ስለ ኃጢአት መባንና መስዋዕትን ሊያቀርብ ከሰው ተመርጦ ለእግዚአብሔር በሆነው ነገር ሁሉ ስለ ሰው ይሾማልና፤

verses.en: Who can have compassion on the ignorant, and on them that are out of the way; for that he himself also is compassed with infirmity.
verses.am: እርሱ ራሱም ደግሞ ድካምን ስለሚለብስ፥ ላልተማሩትና ለሚስቱት ሊራራላቸው ይችላል፤

verses.en: And by reason hereof he ought, as for the people, so also for himself, to offer for sins.
verses.am: በዚህም ምክንያት ስለ ሕዝብ እንደሚያቀርብ እንዲሁ ስለ ራሱ ደግሞ መስዋዕትን ስለ ኃጢአት ሊያቀርብ ይገባዋል።

verses.en: And no man taketh this honour unto himself, but he that is called of YAHUAH, as was Aaron.
verses.am: እንደ አሮንም በእግዚአብሔር ከተጠራ በቀር ማንም ክብሩን ለራሱ የሚወስድ የለም።

verses.en: So also Messiah glorified not himself to be made an high priest; but he that said unto him, Thou art my Son, to day have I begotten thee.
verses.am: እንዲሁ ክርስቶስ ደግሞ ሊቀ ካህናት ሊሆን ራሱን አላከበረም ነገር ግን። አንተ ልጄ ነህ እኔ ዛሬ ወልጄሃለሁ ያለው እርሱ ነው፤

verses.en: As he saith also in another place, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
verses.am: እንደዚህም በሌላ ስፍራ ደግሞ። አንተ እንደ መልከ ጼዴቅ ሹመት ለዘላለም ካህን ነህ ይላል።

verses.en: Who in the days of his flesh, when he had offered up prayers and supplications with strong crying and tears unto him that was able to save him from death, and was heard in that he feared;
verses.am: እርሱም በስጋው ወራት ከሞት ሊያድነው ወደሚችል ከብርቱ ጩኸትና ከእንባ ጋር ጸሎትንና ምልጃን አቀረበ፥ እግዚአብሔርንም ስለ መፍራቱ ተሰማለት፤

verses.en: Though he were a Son, yet learned he obedience by the things which he suffered;
verses.am: ምንም ልጅ ቢሆን፥ ከተቀበለው መከራ መታዘዝን ተማረ፤

verses.en: And being made perfect, he became the author of eternal salvation unto all them that obey him;
verses.am: ስለ እርሱም የምንናገረው ብዙ ነገር አለን፥ ጆሮቻችሁም ስለ ፈዘዙ በቃል ልንተረጕመው ጭንቅ ነው።

verses.en: Called of YAHUAH an high priest after the order of Melchisedec.
verses.am: ስለ እርሱም የምንናገረው ብዙ ነገር አለን፥ ጆሮቻችሁም ስለ ፈዘዙ በቃል ልንተረጕመው ጭንቅ ነው።

verses.en: Of whom we have many things to say, and hard to be uttered, seeing ye are dull of hearing.
verses.am: ከጊዜው የተነሳ አስተማሪዎች ልትሆኑ ሲገባችሁ፥ አንድ ሰው ስለ እግዚአብሔር ቃላት መጀመሪያ ያለውን የሕፃንነትን ትምህርት እንዲያስተምራችሁ እንደ ገና ያስፈልጋችኋልና፤ የሚያስፈልጋችሁም ወተት ነው እንጂ ጠንካራ ምግብ አይደለም።

verses.en: For when for the time ye ought to be teachers, ye have need that one teach you again which be the first principles of the oracles of YAHUAH; and are become such as have need of milk, and not of strong meat.
verses.am: ወተት የሚጋት ሁሉ ሕፃን ስለ ሆነ የጽድቅን ቃል አያውቅምና፤

verses.en: For every one that useth milk is unskilful in the word of righteousness: for he is a babe.
verses.am: ጠንካራ ምግብ ግን መልካሙንና ክፉውን ለመለየት በስራቸው የለመደ ልቡና ላላቸው ለፍጹማን ሰዎች ነው።

verses.en: But strong meat belongeth to them that are of full age, even those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern both good and evil.
Therefore leaving the principles of the doctrine of Messiah, let us go on unto perfection; not laying again the foundation of repentance from dead works, and of faith toward YAHUAH,
verses.am: ስለዚህ የክርስቶስን ነገር መጀመሪያ የሚናገረውን ቃል ትተን ወደ ፍጻሜ እንሂድ፤ መሠረትን ደግመን አንመሥርት፥

verses.en: Of the doctrine of baptisms, and of laying on of hands, and of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.
verses.am: እርሱም ከሞተ ሥራ ንስሐና በእግዚአብሔር እምነት፥ ስለ ጥምቀቶችና እጆችንም ስለ መጫን ስለ ሙታንም ትንሣኤ ስለ ዘላለም ፍርድም ትምህርት ነው።

verses.en: And this will we do, if YAHUAH permit.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ቢፈቅድ ይህን እናደርጋለን።

verses.en: For it is impossible for those who were once enlightened, and have tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Set-apart Spirit,
verses.am: አንድ ጊዜ ብርሃን የበራላቸውን ሰማያዊውንም ስጦታ የቀመሱትን ከመንፈስ ቅዱስም ተካፋዮች ሆነው የነበሩትን

verses.en: And have tasted the good word of YAHUAH, and the powers of the world to come,
verses.am: መልካሙንም የእግዚአብሔርን ቃልና ሊመጣ ያለውን የዓለም ኃይል የቀመሱትን

verses.en: If they shall fall away, to renew them again unto repentance; seeing they crucify to themselves the Son of YAHUAH afresh, and put him to an open shame.
verses.am: በኋላም የካዱትን እንደገና ለንስሐ እነርሱን ማደስ የማይቻል ነው፤ ለራሳቸው የእግዚአብሔርን ልጅ ይሰቅሉታልና ያዋርዱትማልና።

verses.en: For the earth which drinketh in the rain that cometh oft upon it, and bringeth forth herbs meet for them by whom it is dressed, receiveth blessing from YAHUAH:
verses.am: ብዙ ጊዜ በእርስዋ ላይ የሚወርደውን ዝናብ የምትጠጣ መሬት፥ ለሚያርሱአትም ደግሞ የምትጠቅምን አትክልት የምታበቅል፥ ከእግዚአብሔር በረከትን ታገኛለችና፤

verses.en: But that which beareth thorns and briers is rejected, and is nigh unto cursing; whose end is to be burned.
verses.am: እሾህና ኵርንችትን ግን ብታወጣ፥ የተጣለች ናት ለመረገምም ትቀርባለች፥ መጨረሻዋም መቃጠል ነው።

verses.en: But, beloved, we are persuaded better things of you, and things that accompany salvation, though we thus speak.
verses.am: ስለ እናንተ ግን፥ ወዳጆች ሆይ፥ ምንም እንኳ እንዲሁ ብንናገር፥ አብልጦ የሚሻለውና ለመዳን የሚሆነው እንዲሆንላችሁ ተረድተናል።

verses.en: For YAHUAH is not unrighteous to forget your work and labour of love, which ye have shewed toward his name, in that ye have ministered to the saints, and do minister.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር፥ ቅዱሳንን ስላገለገላችሁ እስከ አሁንም ስለምታገለግሉአቸው፥ ያደረጋችሁትን ሥራ ለስሙም ያሳያችሁትን ፍቅር ይረሳ ዘንድ ዓመፀኛ አይደለምና።

verses.en: And we desire that every one of you do shew the same diligence to the full assurance of hope unto the end:
verses.am: እንዲሁም እርሱ ከታገሰ በኋላ ተስፋውን አገኘ።

verses.en: That ye be not slothful, but followers of them who through faith and patience inherit the promises.
verses.am: እንዲሁም እርሱ ከታገሰ በኋላ ተስፋውን አገኘ።

verses.en: For when YAHUAH made promise to Abraham, because he could swear by no greater, he sware by himself,
verses.am: እንዲሁም እርሱ ከታገሰ በኋላ ተስፋውን አገኘ።

verses.en: Saying, Surely blessing I will bless thee, and multiplying I will multiply thee.
verses.am: ሰዎች ከእነርሱ በሚበልጠው ይምላሉና፥ ለማስረዳትም የሆነው መሐላ የሙግት ሁሉ ፍጻሜ ይሆናል፤

verses.en: And so, after he had patiently endured, he obtained the promise.
verses.am: ይህም ተስፋ እንደ ነፍስ መልሕቅ አለን እርሱም እርግጥና ጽኑ የሆነ ወደ መጋረጃውም ውስጥ የገባ ነው፤

verses.en: For men verily swear by the greater: and an oath for confirmation is to them an end of all strife.
verses.am: ይህም ተስፋ እንደ ነፍስ መልሕቅ አለን እርሱም እርግጥና ጽኑ የሆነ ወደ መጋረጃውም ውስጥ የገባ ነው፤

verses.en: Wherein YAHUAH, willing more abundantly to shew unto the heirs of promise the immutability of his counsel, confirmed it by an oath:
verses.am: በዚያም ኢየሱስ እንደ መልከ ጼዴቅ ሹመት ለዘላለም ሊቀ ካህናት የሆነው፥ ስለ እኛ ቀዳሚ ሆኖ ገባ።

verses.en: That by two immutable things, in which it was impossible for YAHUAH to lie, we might have a strong consolation, who have fled for refuge to lay hold upon the hope set before us:
Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and stedfast, and which entereth into that within the veil;
Whither the forerunner is for us entered, even Yahushua, made an high priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
For this Melchisedec, king of Salem, priest of the most high YAHUAH, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings, and blessed him;
verses.am: የሳሌም ንጉሥና የልዑል እግዚአብሔር ካህን የሆነ ይህ መልከ ጼዴቅ አብርሃም ነገሥታትን ገድሎ ሲመለስ ከእርሱ ጋር ተገናኝቶ ባረከው፤

verses.en: To whom also Abraham gave a tenth part of all; first being by interpretation King of righteousness, and after that also King of Salem, which is, King of peace;
verses.am: ለእርሱም ደግሞ አብርሃም ከሁሉ አስራትን አካፈለው። የስሙም ትርጓሜ በመጀመሪያ የጽድቅ ንጉሥ ነው፥ ኋላም ደግሞ የሳሌም ንጉሥ ማለት የሰላም ንጉሥ ነው።

verses.en: Without father, without mother, without descent, having neither beginning of days, nor end of life; but made like unto the Son of YAHUAH; abideth a priest continually.
verses.am: አባትና እናት የትውልድም ቍጥር የሉትም፥ ለዘመኑም ጥንት ለህይወቱም ፍጻሜ የለውም፥ ዳሩ ግን በእግዚአብሔር ልጅ ተመስሎ ለዘላለም ካህን ሆኖ ይኖራል።

verses.en: Now consider how great this man was, unto whom even the patriarch Abraham gave the tenth of the spoils.
verses.am: የአባቶች አለቃ አብርሃም ከዘረፋው የሚሻለውን አስራት የሰጠው ይህ ሰው እንዴት ትልቅ እንደ ነበረ እስኪ ተመልከቱ።

verses.en: And verily they that are of the sons of Levi, who receive the office of the priesthood, have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law, that is, of their brethren, though they come out of the loins of Abraham:
verses.am: ከሌዊ ልጆችም ክህነትን የሚቀበሉት ከህዝቡ ማለት ከወንድሞቻቸው፥ እነርሱ ምንም ከአብርሃም ወገብ ቢወጡ፥ ከእነርሱ አሥራትን በሕግ እንዲያስወጡ ትእዛዝ አላቸው፤

verses.en: But he whose descent is not counted from them received tithes of Abraham, and blessed him that had the promises.
verses.am: ትውልዱ ከእነርሱ የማይቈጠረው ግን ከአብርሃም አሥራትን አውጥቶአል፥ የተስፋ ቃል የነበረውንም ባርኮአል።

verses.en: And without all contradiction the less is blessed of the better.
verses.am: ትንሹም በታላቁ እንዲባረክ ክርክር የሌለበት ነገር ነው።

verses.en: And here men that die receive tithes; but there he receiveth them, of whom it is witnessed that he liveth.
verses.am: በዚህስ የሚሞቱ ሰዎች አሥራትን ያስወጣሉ፥ በዚያ ግን የሚያስወጣ በሕይወት እንዲኖር የተመሰከረለት እርሱ ነው።

verses.en: And as I may so say, Levi also, who receiveth tithes, payed tithes in Abraham.
verses.am: ይህንም ለማለት ሲፈቀድ፥ አሥራትን የሚያስወጣ ሌዊ እንኳ በአብርሃም እጅ አሥራትን ሰጥቶአል፤

verses.en: For he was yet in the loins of his father, when Melchisedec met him.
verses.am: መልከ ጼዴቅ በተገናኘው ጊዜ ገና በአባቱ ወገብ ነበረና።

verses.en: If therefore perfection were by the Levitical priesthood, (for under it the people received the law,) what further need was there that another priest should rise after the order of Melchisedec, and not be called after the order of Aaron?
verses.am: እንግዲህ ህዝቡ በሌዊ ክህነት የተመሠረተን ሕግ ተቀብለዋልና በዚያ ክህነት ፍጹምነት የተገኘ ቢሆን፥ እንደ አሮን ሹመት የማይቈጠር፥ እንደ መልከ ጼዴቅ ሹመት ግን የሆነ ሌላ ካህን ሊነሳ ወደፊት ስለ ምን ያስፈልጋል?

verses.en: For the priesthood being changed, there is made of necessity a change also of the law.
verses.am: ክህነቱ ሲለወጥ፥ ሕጉ ደግሞ ሊለወጥ የግድ ነውና።

verses.en: For he of whom these things are spoken pertaineth to another tribe, of which no man gave attendance at the altar.
verses.am: ይህ ነገር የተነገረለት እርሱ በሌላ ወገን ተካፍሎአልና፥ ከዚያም መሠዊያውን ያገለገለ ማንም የለም፤

verses.en: For it is evident that our Master sprang out of Juda; of which tribe Mosheh spake nothing concerning priesthood.
verses.am: ጌታችን ከይሁዳ ነገድ እንደወጣ የተገለጠ ነውና፥ ስለዚህም ነገድ ሙሴ ምንም እንኳ ስለ ክህነት አልተናገረም።

verses.en: And it is yet far more evident: for that after the similitude of Melchisedec there ariseth another priest,
verses.am: አንተ እንደ መልከ ጼዴቅ ሹመት ለዘላለም ካህን ነህ ብሎ ይመሰክራልና።

verses.en: Who is made, not after the law of a carnal commandment, but after the power of an endless life.
verses.am: አንተ እንደ መልከ ጼዴቅ ሹመት ለዘላለም ካህን ነህ ብሎ ይመሰክራልና።

verses.en: For he testifieth, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
verses.am: እንዲሁ ኢየሱስ ለሚሻል ኪዳን ዋስ ሆኖአል።

verses.en: For there is verily a disannulling of the commandment going before for the weakness and unprofitableness thereof.
verses.am: እንዲሁ ኢየሱስ ለሚሻል ኪዳን ዋስ ሆኖአል።

verses.en: For the law made nothing perfect, but the bringing in of a better hope did; by the which we draw nigh unto YAHUAH.
verses.am: እንዲሁ ኢየሱስ ለሚሻል ኪዳን ዋስ ሆኖአል።

verses.en: And inasmuch as not without an oath he was made priest:
verses.am: እነርሱም እንዳይኖሩ ሞት ስለ ከለከላቸው ካህናት የሆኑት ብዙ ናቸው፤

verses.en: (For those priests were made without an oath; but this with an oath by him that said unto him, The Master sware and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec:)
verses.am: እርሱ ግን ለዘላለም የሚኖር ስለሆነ የማይለወጥ ክህነት አለው፤

verses.en: By so much was Yahushua made a surety of a better testament.
verses.am: ስለ እነርሱም ሊያማልድ ዘወትር በሕይወት ይኖራልና ስለዚህ ደግሞ በእርሱ ወደ እግዚአብሔር የሚመጡትን ፈጽሞ ሊያድናቸው ይችላል።

verses.en: And they truly were many priests, because they were not suffered to continue by reason of death:
verses.am: ቅዱስና ያለ ተንኮል ነውርም የሌለበት ከኃጢአተኞችም የተለየ ከሰማያትም ከፍ ከፍ ያለ፥ እንደዚህ ያለ ሊቀ ካህናት ይገባልና፤

verses.en: But this man, because he continueth ever, hath an unchangeable priesthood.
verses.am: እርሱም እንደነዚያ ሊቃነ ካህናት አስቀድሞ ስለ ራሱ ኃጢአት በኋላም ስለ ሕዝቡ ኃጢአት ዕለት ዕለት መሥዋዕትን ሊያቀርብ አያስፈልገውም፤ ራሱን ባቀረበ ጊዜ ይህን አንድ ጊዜ ፈጽሞ አድርጎአልና።

verses.en: Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto YAHUAH by him, seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them.
verses.am: ሕጉ ድካም ያላቸውን ሰዎች ሊቀ ካህናት አድርጎ ይሾማልና፤ ከሕግ በኋላ የመጣ የመሐላው ቃል ግን ለዘላለም ፍጹም የሆነውን ልጅ ይሾማል።

verses.en: For such an high priest became us, who is holy, harmless, undefiled, separate from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;
Who needeth not daily, as those high priests, to offer up sacrifice, first for his own sins, and then for the people's: for this he did once, when he offered up himself.
For the law maketh men high priests which have infirmity; but the word of the oath, which was since the law, maketh the Son, who is consecrated for evermore.
Now of the things which we have spoken this is the sum: We have such an high priest, who is set on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens;
verses.am: ከተናገርነውም ዋና ነገሩ ይህ ነው፤ በሰማያት በግርማው ዙፋን ቀኝ የተቀመጠ እንዲህ ያለ ሊቀ ካህናት አለን፤

verses.en: A minister of the sanctuary, and of the true tabernacle, which the Master pitched, and not man.
verses.am: እርሱም የመቅደስና የእውነተኛይቱ ድንኳን አገልጋይ ነው፥ እርስዋም በሰው ሳይሆን በጌታ የተተከለች ናት።

verses.en: For every high priest is ordained to offer gifts and sacrifices: wherefore it is of necessity that this man have somewhat also to offer.
verses.am: ሊቀ ካህናት ሁሉ መባንና መሥዋዕትን ሊያቀርብ ይሾማልና፤ ስለዚህም ለዚህ ደግሞ የሚያቀርበው አንዳች ሊኖረው የግድ ነው።

verses.en: For if he were on earth, he should not be a priest, seeing that there are priests that offer gifts according to the law:
verses.am: እንግዲህ በምድር ቢኖርስ፥ እንደ ሕግ መባን የሚያቀርቡት ስላሉ፥ ካህን እንኳ ባልሆነም፤

verses.en: Who serve unto the example and shadow of heavenly things, as Mosheh was admonished of YAHUAH when he was about to make the tabernacle: for, See, saith he, that thou make all things according to the pattern shewed to thee in the mount.
verses.am: እነርሱም ሙሴ ድንኳኒቱን ሊሠራ ሳለ እንደ ተረዳ፥ ለሰማያዊ ነገር ምሳሌና ጥላ የሚሆነውን ያገለግላሉ። በተራራው እንደ ተገለጠልህ ምሳሌ ሁሉን ታደርግ ዘንድ ተጠንቀቅ ብሎት ነበርና።

verses.en: But now hath he obtained a more excellent ministry, by how much also he is the mediator of a better covenant, which was established upon better promises.
verses.am: አሁን ግን በሚሻል ተስፋ ቃል በተመሠረተ በሚሻል ኪዳን ደግሞ መካከለኛ እንደሚሆን በዚያ ልክ እጅግ የሚሻል አገልግሎት አግኝቶአል።

verses.en: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then should no place have been sought for the second.
verses.am: ፊተኛው ኪዳን ነቀፋ ባይኖረው፥ ለሁለተኛው ስፍራ ባልተፈለገም ነበር።

verses.en: For finding fault with them, he saith, Behold, the days come, saith the Master, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Yisra'el and with the house of Yehudah:
verses.am: እነርሱን እየነቀፈ ይላቸዋልና። እነሆ፥ ከእስራኤል ቤትና ከይሁዳ ቤት ጋር አዲስ ኪዳን የምገባበት ወራት ይመጣል ይላል ጌታ፤

verses.en: Not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day when I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Mitsrayim; because they continued not in my covenant, and I regarded them not, saith the Master.
verses.am: ከግብፅ አገር አወጣቸው ዘንድ እጃቸውን በያዝሁበት ቀን ከአባቶቻቸው ጋር እንደገባሁት ኪዳን አይደለም፤ እነርሱ በኪዳኔ አልጸኑምና፥ እኔም ቸል አልኋቸው ይላል ጌታ።

verses.en: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Yisra'el after those days, saith the Master; I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts: and I will be to them a YAHUAH, and they shall be to me a people:
verses.am: ከዚያ ወራት በኋላ ከእስራኤል ቤት ጋር የምገባው ቃል ኪዳን ይህ ነውና ይላል ጌታ፤ ሕጌን በልቡናቸው አኖራለሁ በልባቸውም እጽፈዋለሁ፥ እኔም አምላክ እሆንላቸዋለሁ እነርሱም ሕዝብ ይሆኑልኛል።

verses.en: And they shall not teach every man his neighbour, and every man his brother, saying, Know the Master: for all shall know me, from the least to the greatest.
verses.am: እያንዳንዱም ጐረቤቱን እያንዳንዱም ወንድሙን። ጌታን እወቅ ብሎ አያስተምርም ከታናሹ ጀምሮ እስከ ታላቁ ድረስ ሁሉ ያውቁኛልና።

verses.en: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness, and their sins and their iniquities will I remember no more.
verses.am: ዓመፃቸውን እምራቸዋለሁና፥ ኃጢአታቸውንም ደግሜ አላስብም።

verses.en: In that he saith, A new covenant, he hath made the first old. Now that which decayeth and waxeth old is ready to vanish away.
verses.am: አዲስ በማለቱ ፊተኛውን አስረጅቶአል፤ አሮጌና ውራጅ የሆነውስ ሊጠፋ ቀርቦአል።

verses.en: Then verily the first covenant had also ordinances of divine service, and a worldly sanctuary.
verses.am: ፊተኛይቱም ደግሞ የአገልግሎት ስርዓትና የዚህ ዓለም የሆነው መቅደስ ነበራት።

verses.en: For there was a tabernacle made; the first, wherein was the candlestick, and the table, and the shewbread; which is called the sanctuary.
verses.am: የመጀመሪያይቱ ድንኳን ተዘጋጅታ ነበርና፥ በእርስዋም ቅድስት በምትባለው ውስጥ መቅረዙና ጠረጴዛው የመስዋዕቱም ኅብስት ነበረባት፤

verses.en: And after the second veil, the tabernacle which is called the Holiest of all;
verses.am: ከሁለተኛውም መጋረጃ ወዲያ ቅድስተ ቅዱሳን የምትባለው ድንኳን ነበረች፥

verses.en: Which had the golden censer, and the ark of the covenant overlaid round about with gold, wherein was the golden pot that had manna, and Aaron's rod that budded, and the tables of the covenant;
verses.am: በዚያም ውስጥ የወርቅ ማዕጠንት ነበረ ሁለንተናዋም በወርቅ የተለበጠች የኪዳን ታቦት፤ በእርስዋም ውስጥ መና ያለባት የወርቅ መሶብና የበቀለች የአሮን በትር የኪዳኑም ጽላት ነበሩ፥

verses.en: And over it the cherubims of glory shadowing the mercyseat; of which we cannot now speak particularly.
verses.am: በላይዋም ማስተስሪያውን የሚጋርዱ የክብር ኪሩቤል ነበሩ፤ ስለ እነዚህም ስለ እያንዳንዳቸው ልንናገር አሁን አንችልም።

verses.en: Now when these things were thus ordained, the priests went always into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the service of YAHUAH.
verses.am: ይህም እንደዚህ ተዘጋጅቶ ሳለ፥ ካህናት አገልግሎታቸውን እየፈጸሙ ዘወትር በፊተኛይቱ ድንኳን ይገቡባታል፤

verses.en: But into the second went the high priest alone once every year, not without blood, which he offered for himself, and for the errors of the people:
verses.am: በሁለተኛይቱ ግን ሊቀ ካህናት ብቻውን በዓመት አንድ ጊዜ ይገባባታል፥ እርሱም ሰለ ራሱና ስለ ሕዝቡ ስሕተት የሚያቀርበውን ደም ሳይዝ አይገባም፤

verses.en: The Set-apart Spirit this signifying, that the way into the holiest of all was not yet made manifest, while as the first tabernacle was yet standing:
verses.am: ፊተኛይቱም ድንኳን በዚህ ገና ቆማ ሳለች፥ ወደ ቅድስት የሚወስደው መንገድ ገና እንዳልተገለጠ መንፈስ ቅዱስ ያሳያል።

verses.en: Which was a figure for the time then present, in which were offered both gifts and sacrifices, that could not make him that did the service perfect, as pertaining to the conscience;
verses.am: ነገር ግን ክርስቶስ ይመጣ ዘንድ ላለው መልካም ነገር ሊቀ ካህናት ሆኖ፥ በምትበልጠውና በምትሻለው በእጆችም ባልተሠራች ማለት ለዚህ ፍጥረት ባልሆነች ድንኳን፥

verses.en: Which stood only in meats and drinks, and divers washings, and carnal ordinances, imposed on them until the time of reformation.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ክርስቶስ ይመጣ ዘንድ ላለው መልካም ነገር ሊቀ ካህናት ሆኖ፥ በምትበልጠውና በምትሻለው በእጆችም ባልተሠራች ማለት ለዚህ ፍጥረት ባልሆነች ድንኳን፥

verses.en: But Messiah being come an high priest of good things to come, by a greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this building;
verses.am: የዘላለምን ቤዛነት አግኝቶ አንድ ጊዜ ፈጽሞ ወደ ቅድስት በገዛ ደሙ ገባ እንጂ በፍየሎችና በጥጆች ደም አይደለም።

verses.en: Neither by the blood of goats and calves, but by his own blood he entered in once into the holy place, having obtained eternal redemption for us.
verses.am: የኮርማዎችና የፍየሎች ደም በረከሱትም ላይ የተረጨ የጊደር አመድ ሥጋን ለማንጻት የሚቀድሱ ከሆኑ፥

verses.en: For if the blood of bulls and of goats, and the ashes of an heifer sprinkling the unclean, sanctifieth to the purifying of the flesh:
verses.am: ነውር የሌለው ሆኖ በዘላለም መንፈስ ራሱን ለእግዚአብሔር ያቀረበ የክርስቶስ ደም እንዴት ይልቅ ሕያውን እግዚአብሔርን ልታመልኩ ከሞተ ሥራ ሕሊናችሁን ያነጻ ይሆን?

verses.en: How much more shall the blood of Messiah, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without spot to YAHUAH, purge your conscience from dead works to serve the living YAHUAH?
verses.am: ስለዚህም የፊተኛው ኪዳን ሲጸና ሕግን የተላለፉትን የሚቤዥ ሞት ስለ ሆነ፥ የተጠሩት የዘላለምን ርስት የተስፋ ቃል እንዲቀበሉ እርሱ የአዲስ ኪዳን መካከለኛ ነው።

verses.en: And for this cause he is the mediator of the new testament, that by means of death, for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first testament, they which are called might receive the promise of eternal inheritance.
verses.am: ኑዛዜ ያለ እንደሆነ የተናዛዡን ሞት ማርዳት የግድ ነውና፤

verses.en: For where a testament is, there must also of necessity be the death of the testator.
verses.am: ሰው ሲሞት ኑዛዜው ይጸናልና፥ ተናዛዡ በሕይወት ሲኖር ግን ከቶ አይጠቅምም።

verses.en: For a testament is of force after men are dead: otherwise it is of no strength at all while the testator liveth.
verses.am: ስለዚህም ፊተኛው ኪዳን እንኳ ያለ ደም አልተመረቀም።

verses.en: Whereupon neither the first testament was dedicated without blood.
verses.am: እንዲሁም በድንኳኒቱና በማገልገያው ዕቃ ሁሉ ደምን ረጨ።

verses.en: For when Mosheh had spoken every precept to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of calves and of goats, with water, and scarlet wool, and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book, and all the people,
verses.am: እንዲሁም በድንኳኒቱና በማገልገያው ዕቃ ሁሉ ደምን ረጨ።

verses.en: Saying, This is the blood of the testament which YAHUAH hath enjoined unto you.
verses.am: እንደ ሕጉም ከጥቂቶች በቀር ነገር ሁሉ በደም ይነጻል፥ ደምም ሳይፈስ ስርየት የለም።

verses.en: Moreover he sprinkled with blood both the tabernacle, and all the vessels of the ministry.
verses.am: እንግዲህ በሰማያት ያሉትን የሚመስለው ነገር በዚህ ሊነጻ እንጂ በሰማያት ያሉቱ ራሳቸው ከእርሱ ይልቅ በሚበልጥ መስዋዕት ሊነጹ የግድ ነበረ።

verses.en: And almost all things are by the law purged with blood; and without shedding of blood is no remission.
verses.am: ክርስቶስ በእጅ ወደ ተሰራች፥ የእውነተኛይቱ ምሳሌ ወደ ምትሆን ቅድስት አልገባምና፥ ነገር ግን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ስለ እኛ አሁን ይታይ ዘንድ ወደ እርስዋ ወደ ሰማይ ገባ።

verses.en: It was therefore necessary that the patterns of things in the heavens should be purified with these; but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.
verses.am: ሊቀ ካህናትም በየዓመቱ የሌላውን ደም ይዞ ወደ ቅድስት እንደሚገባ፥ ራሱን ብዙ ጊዜ ሊያቀርብ አልገባም፤

verses.en: For Messiah is not entered into the holy places made with hands, which are the figures of the true; but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of YAHUAH for us:
verses.am: እንዲህ ቢሆንስ፥ ዓለም ከተፈጠረ ጀምሮ ብዙ ጊዜ መከራ ሊቀበል ባስፈለገው ነበር፤ አሁን ግን በዓለም ፍጻሜ ራሱን በመሠዋት ኃጢአትን ሊሽር አንድ ጊዜ ተገልጦአል።

verses.en: Nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest entereth into the holy place every year with blood of others;
verses.am: ለሰዎችም አንድ ጊዜ መሞት ከእርሱ በኋላም ፍርድ እንደ ተመደበባቸው፥

verses.en: For then must he often have suffered since the foundation of the world: but now once in the end of the world hath he appeared to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.
verses.am: እንዲሁ ክርስቶስ ደግሞ፥ የብዙዎችን ኃጢአት ሊሸከም አንድ ጊዜ ከተሰዋ በኋላ፥ ያድናቸው ዘንድ ለሚጠባበቁት ሁለተኛ ጊዜ ያለ ኃጢአት ይታይላቸዋል።

verses.en: And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment:
So Messiah was once offered to bear the sins of many; and unto them that look for him shall he appear the second time without sin unto salvation.

For the law having a shadow of good things to come, and not the very image of the things, can never with those sacrifices which they offered year by year continually make the comers thereunto perfect.
verses.am: ሕጉ ሊመጣ ያለው የበጎ ነገር እውነተኛ አምሳል ሳይሆን የነገር ጥላ አለውና፥ ስለዚህም በየዓመቱ ዘወትር በሚያቀርቡት በዚያ መሥዋዕት የሚቀርቡትን ሊፈጽም ከቶ አይችልም።

verses.en: For then would they not have ceased to be offered? because that the worshippers once purged should have had no more conscience of sins.
verses.am: እንደዚህማ ባይሆን፥ የሚያመልኩት አንድ ጊዜ ነጽተው ከዚያ በኋላ በሕሊናቸው ኃጢአትን ስላላወቁ ማቅረብን በተዉ አልነበረምን?

verses.en: But in those sacrifices there is a remembrance again made of sins every year.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በዚያ መሥዋዕት በየዓመቱ የኃጢአት መታሰቢያ አለ፤

verses.en: For it is not possible that the blood of bulls and of goats should take away sins.
verses.am: የኮርማዎችና የፍየሎች ደም ኃጢአትን እንዲያስወግድ የማይቻል ነውና።

verses.en: Wherefore when he cometh into the world, he saith, Sacrifice and offering thou wouldest not, but a body hast thou prepared me:
verses.am: ስለዚህ ወደ ዓለም ሲገባ። መሥዋዕትንና መባን አልወደድህም ሥጋን ግን አዘጋጀህልኝ፤

verses.en: In burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin thou hast had no pleasure.
verses.am: በሙሉ በሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትና ሰለ ኃጢአት በሚሰዋ መሥዋዕት ደስ አላለህም።

verses.en: Then said I, Lo, I come (in the volume of the book it is written of me,) to do thy will, O YAHUAH.
verses.am: በዚያን ጊዜ። እነሆ፥ በመጽሐፍ ጥቅልል ስለ እኔ እንደ ተጻፈ፥ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ፈቃድህን ላደርግ መጥቼአለሁ አልሁ

verses.en: Above when he said, Sacrifice and offering and burnt offerings and offering for sin thou wouldest not, neither hadst pleasure therein; which are offered by the law;
verses.am: ይላል። በዚህ ላይ። መሥዋዕትንና መባን በሙሉ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትንም ስለ ኃጢአትም የሚሰዋ መሥዋዕትን አልወደድህም በእርሱም ደስ አላለህም ብሎ፥ እነዚህም እንደ ሕግ የሚቀርቡት ናቸው፥

verses.en: Then said he, Lo, I come to do thy will, O YAHUAH. He taketh away the first, that he may establish the second.
verses.am: ቀጥሎ። እነሆ፥ አምላኬ ሆይ፥ ፈቃድህን ላደርግ መጥቼአለሁ ብሎአል። ሁለተኛውንም ሊያቆም የፊተኛውን ይሽራል።

verses.en: By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Yahushua the Messiah once for all.
verses.am: በዚህም ፈቃድ የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስን ሥጋ አንድ ጊዜ ፈጽሞ በማቅረብ ተቀድሰናል።

verses.en: And every priest standeth daily ministering and offering oftentimes the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins:
verses.am: ሊቀ ካህናትም ሁሉ ዕለት ዕለት እያገለገለ ኃጢአትን ሊያስወግዱ ከቶ የማይችሉትን እነዚያን መሥዋዕቶች ብዙ ጊዜ እያቀረበ ቆሞአል፤

verses.en: But this man, after he had offered one sacrifice for sins for ever, sat down on the right hand of YAHUAH;
verses.am: እርሱ ግን ስለ ኃጢአት አንድን መሥዋዕት ለዘላለም አቅርቦ በእግዚአብሔር ቀኝ ተቀመጠ፥

verses.en: From henceforth expecting till his enemies be made his footstool.
verses.am: ጠላቶቹም የእግሩ መረገጫ እስኪደረጉ ድረስ ወደ ፊት ይጠብቃል።

verses.en: For by one offering he hath perfected for ever them that are sanctified.
verses.am: አንድ ጊዜ በማቅረብ የሚቀደሱትን የዘላለም ፍጹማን አድርጎአቸዋልና።

verses.en: Whereof the Set-apart Spirit also is a witness to us: for after that he had said before,
verses.am: ብሎ ከተናገረ በኋላ፥ ኃጢአታቸውንና ዓመጻቸውንም ደግሜ አላስብም ይላል።

verses.en: This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days, saith the Master, I will put my laws into their hearts, and in their minds will I write them;
verses.am: ብሎ ከተናገረ በኋላ፥ ኃጢአታቸውንና ዓመጻቸውንም ደግሜ አላስብም ይላል።

verses.en: And their sins and iniquities will I remember no more.
verses.am: የእነዚህም ስርየት ባለበት ዘንድ፥ ከዚህ ወዲህ ስለ ኃጢአት ማቅረብ የለም።

verses.en: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ላይ የሆነ ታላቅ ካህን ስላለን፥

verses.en: Having therefore, brethren, boldness to enter into the holiest by the blood of Yahushua,
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ላይ የሆነ ታላቅ ካህን ስላለን፥

verses.en: By a new and living way, which he hath consecrated for us, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh;
verses.am: ከክፉ ሕሊና ለመንጻት ልባችንን ተረጭተን ሰውነታችንንም በጥሩ ውኃ ታጥበን በተረዳንበት እምነት በቅን ልብ እንቅረብ፤

verses.en: And having an high priest over the house of YAHUAH;
verses.am: የተስፋን ቃል የሰጠው የታመነ ነውና እንዳይነቃነቅ የተስፋችንን ምስክርነት እንጠብቅ፤

verses.en: Let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and our bodies washed with pure water.
verses.am: ለፍቅርና ለመልካምም ሥራ እንድንነቃቃ እርስ በርሳችን እንተያይ፤

verses.en: Let us hold fast the profession of our faith without wavering; (for he is faithful that promised;)
verses.am: በአንዳንዶችም ዘንድ ልማድ እንደ ሆነው፥ መሰብሰባችንን አንተው እርስ በርሳችን እንመካከር እንጂ፤ ይልቁንም ቀኑ ሲቀርብ እያያችሁ አብልጣችሁ ይህን አድርጉ።

verses.en: And let us consider one another to provoke unto love and to good works:
verses.am: የእውነትን እውቀት ከተቀበልን በኋላ ወደን ኃጢአት ብናደርግ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ስለ ኃጢአት መሥዋዕት አይቀርልንምና፥

verses.en: Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together, as the manner of some is; but exhorting one another: and so much the more, as ye see the day approaching.
verses.am: የሚያስፈራ ግን የፍርድ መጠበቅ ተቃዋሚዎችንም ሊበላ ያለው የእሳት ብርታት አለ።

verses.en: For if we sin wilfully after that we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remaineth no more sacrifice for sins,
verses.am: የሙሴን ሕግ የናቀ ሰው ሁለት ወይም ሦስት ቢመሰክሩበት ያለ ርኅራኄ ይሞታል፤

verses.en: But a certain fearful looking for of judgment and fiery indignation, which shall devour the adversaries.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ልጅ የረገጠ ያንንም የተቀደሰበትን የኪዳኑን ደም እንደ ርኵስ ነገር የቆጠረ የጸጋውንም መንፈስ ያክፋፋ፥ እንዴት ይልቅ የሚብስ ቅጣት የሚገባው ይመስላችኋል?

verses.en: He that despised Mosheh' law died without mercy under two or three witnesses:
verses.am: በቀል የእኔ ነው፥ እኔ ብድራትን እመልሳለሁ ያለውን እናውቃለንና፤ ደግሞም። ጌታ በሕዝቡ ይፈርዳል።

verses.en: Of how much sorer punishment, suppose ye, shall he be thought worthy, who hath trodden under foot the Son of YAHUAH, and hath counted the blood of the covenant, wherewith he was sanctified, an unholy thing, and hath done despite unto the Spirit of grace?
verses.am: በሕያው እግዚአብሔር እጅ መውደቅ የሚያስፈራ ነው።

verses.en: For we know him that hath said, Vengeance belongeth unto me, I will recompense, saith the Master. And again, The Master shall judge his people.
verses.am: የሚበልጥና ለዘወትር የሚኖር ገንዘብ በሰማይ ራሳችሁ እንዳላችሁ አውቃችሁ፥ በእስራቴ ራራችሁልኝ የገንዘባችሁንም ንጥቂያ በደስታ ተቀበላችሁ።

verses.en: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living YAHUAH.
verses.am: የሚበልጥና ለዘወትር የሚኖር ገንዘብ በሰማይ ራሳችሁ እንዳላችሁ አውቃችሁ፥ በእስራቴ ራራችሁልኝ የገንዘባችሁንም ንጥቂያ በደስታ ተቀበላችሁ።

verses.en: But call to remembrance the former days, in which, after ye were illuminated, ye endured a great fight of afflictions;
verses.am: እንግዲህ ታላቅ ብድራት ያለውን ድፍረታችሁን አትጣሉ።

verses.en: Partly, whilst ye were made a gazingstock both by reproaches and afflictions; and partly, whilst ye became companions of them that were so used.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ፈቃድ አድርጋችሁ የተሰጣችሁን የተስፋ ቃል እንድታገኙ መጽናት ያስፈልጋችኋልና።

verses.en: For ye had compassion of me in my bonds, and took joyfully the spoiling of your goods, knowing in yourselves that ye have in heaven a better and an enduring substance. yourselves}
verses.am: ገና በጣም ጥቂት ጊዜ ነው፥ ሊመጣ ያለውም ይመጣል አይዘገይምም፤

verses.en: Cast not away therefore your confidence, which hath great recompence of reward.
verses.am: ጻድቅ ግን በእምነት ይኖራል ወደ ኋላም ቢያፈገፍግ፥ ነፍሴ በእርሱ ደስ አይላትም።

verses.en: For ye have need of patience, that, after ye have done the will of YAHUAH, ye might receive the promise.
verses.am: እኛ ግን ነፍሳቸውን ሊያድኑ ከሚያምኑቱ ነን እንጂ ወደ ጥፋት ከሚያፈገፍጉ አይደለንም።

verses.en: For yet a little while, and he that shall come will come, and will not tarry.
Now the just shall live by faith: but if any man draw back, my soul shall have no pleasure in him.
But we are not of them who draw back unto perdition; but of them that believe to the saving of the soul.
Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
verses.am: እምነትም ተስፋ ስለምናደርገው ነገር የሚያስረግጥ፥ የማናየውንም ነገር የሚያስረዳ ነው።

verses.en: For by it the elders obtained a good report.
verses.am: ለሽማግሌዎች የተመሰከረላቸው በዚህ ነውና።

verses.en: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of YAHUAH, so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.
verses.am: ዓለሞች በእግዚአብሔር ቃል እንደ ተዘጋጁ፥ ስለዚህም የሚታየው ነገር ከሚታዩት እንዳልሆነ በእምነት እናስተውላለን።

verses.en: By faith Abel offered unto YAHUAH a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained witness that he was righteous, YAHUAH testifying of his gifts: and by it he being dead yet speaketh.
verses.am: አቤል ከቃየል ይልቅ የሚበልጥን መሥዋዕት ለእግዚአብሔር በእምነት አቀረበ፥ በዚህም፥ እግዚአብሔር ስለ ስጦታው ሲመሰክር፥ እርሱ ጻድቅ እንደ ሆነ ተመሰከረለት፤ ሞቶም ሳለ በመሥዋዕቱ እስከ አሁን ይናገራል።

verses.en: By faith Hanok was translated that he should not see death; and was not found, because YAHUAH had translated him: for before his translation he had this testimony, that he pleased YAHUAH.
verses.am: ሄኖክ ሞትን እንዳያይ በእምነት ተወሰደ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ስለ ወሰደው አልተገኘም። ሳይወሰድ እግዚአብሔርን ደስ እንዳሰኘ ተመስክሮለታልና፤

verses.en: But without faith it is impossible to please him: for he that cometh to YAHUAH must believe that he is, and that he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
verses.am: ያለ እምነትም ደስ ማሰኘት አይቻልም፤ ወደ እግዚአብሔር የሚደርስ እግዚአብሔር እንዳለ ለሚፈልጉትም ዋጋ እንዲሰጥ ያምን ዘንድ ያስፈልገዋልና።

verses.en: By faith Noah, being warned of YAHUAH of things not seen as yet, moved with fear, prepared an ark to the saving of his house; by the which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is by faith.
verses.am: ኖኅ ገና ስለማይታየው ነገር ተረድቶ እግዚአብሔርን እየፈራ ቤተ ስዎቹን ለማዳን መርከብን በእምነት አዘጋጀ፥ በዚህም ዓለምን ኰነነ፥ በእምነትም የሚገኘውን ጽድቅ ወራሽ ሆነ።

verses.en: By faith Abraham, when he was called to go out into a place which he should after receive for an inheritance, obeyed; and he went out, not knowing whither he went.
verses.am: አብርሃም የተባለው ርስት አድርጎ ሊቀበለው ወዳለው ስፍራ ለመውጣት በእምነት ታዘዘ፥ ወዴትም እንደሚሄድ ሳያውቅ ወጣ።

verses.en: By faith he sojourned in the land of promise, as in a strange country, dwelling in tabernacles with Yitschaq and Ya'aqob, the heirs with him of the same promise:
verses.am: ለእንግዶች እንደሚሆን በተስፋ ቃል በተሰጠው አገር በድንኳን ኖሮ፥ ያን የተስፋ ቃል አብረውት ከሚወርሱ ከይስሐቅና ከያዕቆብ ጋር፥ እንደ መጻተኛ በእምነት ተቀመጠ፤

verses.en: For he looked for a city which hath foundations, whose builder and maker is YAHUAH.
verses.am: መሠረት ያላትን፥ እግዚአብሔር የሠራትንና የፈጠራትን ከተማ ይጠብቅ ነበርና።

verses.en: Through faith also Sara herself received strength to conceive seed, and was delivered of a child when she was past age, because she judged him faithful who had promised.
verses.am: ተስፋ የሰጠው የታመነ እንደ ሆነ ስለ ቈጠረች፥ ሣራ ራስዋ ደግሞ ዕድሜዋ እንኳ ካለፈ በኋላ ዘርን ለመፅነስ ኃይልን በእምነት አገኘች።

verses.en: Therefore sprang there even of one, and him as good as dead, so many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as the sand which is by the sea shore innumerable.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ደግሞ በብዛታቸው እንደ ሰማይ ኮከብ እንደማይቈጠርም በባሕር ዳር እንዳለ አሸዋ የነበሩት የሞተን ሰው እንኳ ከመሰለው ከአንዱ ተወለዱ።

verses.en: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them afar off, and were persuaded of them, and embraced them, and confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.
verses.am: እነዚህ ሁሉ አምነው ሞቱ፥ የተሰጣቸውን የተስፋ ቃል አላገኙምና፤ ዳሩ ግን ከሩቅ ሆነው አዩትና ተሳለሙት፥ በምድሪቱም እንግዶችና መጻተኞች እንዲሆኑ ታመኑ።

verses.en: For they that say such things declare plainly that they seek a country.
verses.am: እንዲህ የሚሉት ለእነርሱ የሚሆነውን አገር እንዲፈልጉ ያመለክታሉና።

verses.en: And truly, if they had been mindful of that country from whence they came out, they might have had opportunity to have returned.
verses.am: ያን የወጡበትን አገር አስበው ቢሆኑ፥ ሊመለሱ ጊዜ በሆነላቸው ነበር፤

verses.en: But now they desire a better country, that is, an heavenly: wherefore YAHUAH is not ashamed to be called their YAHUAH: for he hath prepared for them a city.
verses.am: አሁን ግን የሚበልጠውን እርሱም ሰማያዊ አገር ይናፍቃሉ። ስለዚህ እግዚአብሔር አምላካቸው ተብሎ ሊጠራ በእነርሱ አያፍርም፥ ከተማን አዘጋጅቶላቸዋልና።

verses.en: By faith Abraham, when he was tried, offered up Yitschaq: and he that had received the promises offered up his only begotten son,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ከሙታን እንኳ ሊያስነሣው እንዲቻለው አስቦአልና፥ ከዚያም ደግሞ በምሳሌ አገኘው።

verses.en: Of whom it was said, That in Yitschaq shall thy seed be called:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ከሙታን እንኳ ሊያስነሣው እንዲቻለው አስቦአልና፥ ከዚያም ደግሞ በምሳሌ አገኘው።

verses.en: Accounting that YAHUAH was able to raise him up, even from the dead; from whence also he received him in a figure.
verses.am: ይስሐቅ ሊመጣ ስላለው ነገር ያዕቆብንና ዔሳውን በእምነት ባረካቸው።

verses.en: By faith Yitschaq blessed Ya'aqob and Esau concerning things to come.
verses.am: ያዕቆብ ሲሞት በእምነት የዮሴፍን ልጆች እያንዳንዳቸው ባረካቸው፥ በዘንጉም ጫፍ ተጠግቶ ሰገደ።

verses.en: By faith Ya'aqob, when he was a dying, blessed both the sons of Yoseph; and worshipped, leaning upon the top of his staff.
verses.am: ዮሴፍ ወደ ሞት ቀርቦ ሳለ በእምነት ስለ እስራኤል ልጆች መውጣት አስታወሰ፥ ስለ አጥንቱም አዘዛቸው።

verses.en: By faith Yoseph, when he died, made mention of the departing of the children of Yisra'el; and gave commandment concerning his bones.
verses.am: ሙሴ ከተወለደ በኋላ ወላጆቹ ያማረ ሕፃን መሆኑን አይተው በእምነት ሦስት ወር ሸሸጉት የንጉሥንም አዋጅ አልፈሩም።

verses.en: By faith Mosheh, when he was born, was hid three months of his parents, because they saw he was a proper child; and they were not afraid of the king's commandment.
verses.am: ሙሴ ካደገ በኋላ የፈርዖን የልጅ ልጅ እንዳይባል በእምነት እምቢ አለ፤

verses.en: By faith Mosheh, when he was come to years, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter;
verses.am: የንጉሡን ቍጣ ሳይፈራ የግብፅን አገር የተወ በእምነት ነበር፤ የማይታየውን እንደሚያየው አድርጎ ጸንቶአልና።

verses.en: Choosing rather to suffer affliction with the people of YAHUAH, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a season;
verses.am: የንጉሡን ቍጣ ሳይፈራ የግብፅን አገር የተወ በእምነት ነበር፤ የማይታየውን እንደሚያየው አድርጎ ጸንቶአልና።

verses.en: Esteeming the reproach of Messiah greater riches than the treasures in Mitsrayim: for he had respect unto the recompence of the reward.
verses.am: አጥፊው የበኵሮችን ልጆች እንዳይነካ ፋሲካንና ደምን መርጨትን በእምነት አደረገ።

verses.en: By faith he forsook Mitsrayim, not fearing the wrath of the king: for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.
verses.am: በደረቅ ምድር እንደሚያልፉ በኤርትራ ባሕር በእምነት ተሻገሩ፥ የግብፅ ሰዎች ግን ሲሞክሩ ተዋጡ።

verses.en: Through faith he kept the passover, and the sprinkling of blood, lest he that destroyed the firstborn should touch them.
verses.am: የኢያሪኮ ቅጥር ሰባት ቀን ከዞሩበት በኋላ በእምነት ወደቀ።

verses.en: By faith they passed through the Red sea as by dry land: which the Mitsrim assaying to do were drowned.
verses.am: ጋለሞታይቱ ረዓብ ሰላዮችን በሰላም ስለ ተቀበለቻቸው ከማይታዘዙ ጋር በእምነት አልጠፋችም።

verses.en: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down, after they were compassed about seven days.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ምን እላለሁ? ስለ ጌዴዎንና ስለ ባርቅ ስለ ሶምሶንም ስለ ዮፍታሔም ስለ ዳዊትና ስለ ሳሙኤልም ስለ ነቢያትም እንዳልተርክ ጊዜ ያጥርብኛልና።

verses.en: By faith the harlot Rahab perished not with them that believed not, when she had received the spies with peace.
verses.am: እነርሱ በእምነት መንግሥታትን ድል ነሡ፥ ጽድቅን አደረጉ፥ የተሰጠውን የተስፋ ቃል አገኙ፥

verses.en: And what shall I more say? for the time would fail me to tell of Gedeon, and of Barak, and of Samson, and of Jephthae; of Dawid also, and Shemu'el, and of the prophets:
verses.am: የአንበሶችን አፍ ዘጉ፥ የእሳትን ኃይል አጠፉ፥ ከሰይፍ ስለት አመለጡ፥ ከድካማቸው በረቱ፥ በጦርነት ኃይለኞች ሆኑ፥ የባዕድ ጭፍሮችን አባረሩ።

verses.en: Who through faith subdued kingdoms, wrought righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,
verses.am: ሴቶች ሙታናቸውን በትንሣኤ ተቀበሉ፤ ሌሎችም መዳንን ሳይቀበሉ የሚበልጠውን ትንሣኤ እንዲያገኙ እስከ ሞት ድረስ ተደበደቡ፤

verses.en: Quenched the violence of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, out of weakness were made strong, waxed valiant in fight, turned to flight the armies of the aliens.
verses.am: ሌሎችም መዘበቻ በመሆንና በመገረፍ ከዚህም በላይ በእስራትና በወኅኒ ተፈተኑ፤

verses.en: Women received their dead raised to life again: and others were tortured, not accepting deliverance; that they might obtain a better resurrection:
verses.am: በድንጋይ ተወግረው ሞቱ፥ ተፈተኑ፥ በመጋዝ ተሰነጠቁ፥ በሰይፍ ተገድለው ሞቱ፥ ሁሉን እያጡ መከራን እየተቀበሉ እየተጨነቁ የበግና የፍየል ሌጦ ለብሰው ዞሩ፤

verses.en: And others had trial of cruel mockings and scourgings, yea, moreover of bonds and imprisonment:
verses.am: ዓለም አልተገባቸውምና በምድረ በዳና በተራራ፥ በዋሻና በምድር ጕድጓድ ተቅበዘበዙ።

verses.en: They were stoned, they were sawn asunder, were tempted, were slain with the sword: they wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins; being destitute, afflicted, tormented;
(Of whom the world was not worthy:) they wandered in deserts, and in mountains, and in dens and caves of the earth.
And these all, having obtained a good report through faith, received not the promise:
YAHUAH having provided some better thing for us, that they without us should not be made perfect.

Wherefore seeing we also are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,
verses.am: እንግዲህ እነዚህን የሚያህሉ ምስክሮች እንደ ደመና በዙሪያችን ካሉልን፥

verses.en: Looking unto Yahushua the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of YAHUAH.
verses.am: እኛ ደግሞ ሸክምን ሁሉ ቶሎም የሚከበንን ኃጢአት አስወግደን፥ የእምነታችንንም ራስና ፈጻሚውን ኢየሱስን ተመልክተን፥ በፊታችን ያለውን ሩጫ በትዕግሥት እንሩጥ፤ እርሱ ነውርን ንቆ በፊቱም ስላለው ደስታ በመስቀል ታግሦ በእግዚአብሔር ዙፋን ቀኝ ተቀምጦአልና።

verses.en: For consider him that endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, lest ye be wearied and faint in your minds.
verses.am: በነፍሳችሁ ዝላችሁ እንዳትደክሙ፥ ከኃጢአተኞች በደረሰበት እንዲህ ባለ መቃወም የጸናውን አስቡ።

verses.en: Ye have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin.
verses.am: ከኃጢአት ጋር እየተጋደላችሁ ገና ደምን እስከ ማፍሰስ ድረስ አልተቃወማችሁም፤

verses.en: And ye have forgotten the exhortation which speaketh unto you as unto children, My son, despise not thou the chastening of the Master, nor faint when thou art rebuked of him:
For whom the Master loveth he chasteneth, and scourgeth every son whom he receiveth.
verses.am: እንደ ልጆችም ከእናንተ ጋር። ልጄ ሆይ፥ የጌታን ቅጣት አታቅልል፥ በሚገሥጽህም ጊዜ አትድከም፤ ጌታ የሚወደውን ይቀጣዋልና፥ የሚቀበለውንም ልጅ ሁሉ ይገርፈዋል ብሎ የሚነጋገረውን ምክር ረስታችኋል።

verses.en: If ye endure chastening, YAHUAH dealeth with you as with sons; for what son is he whom the father chasteneth not?
verses.am: ለመቀጣት ታገሡ፤ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ልጆች ያደርግላችኋልና፤ አባቱ የማይቀጣው ልጅ ማን ነው?

verses.en: But if ye be without chastisement, whereof all are partakers, then are ye bastards, and not sons.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ሁሉ የቅጣት ተካፋይ ሆኖአልና ያለ ቅጣት ብትኖሩ ዲቃላዎች እንጂ ልጆች አይደላችሁም።

verses.en: Furthermore we have had fathers of our flesh which corrected us, and we gave them reverence: shall we not much rather be in subjection unto the Father of spirits, and live?
verses.am: ከዚህም በላይ የቀጡን የሥጋችን አባቶች ነበሩን እናፍራቸውም ነበር፤ እንዴትስ ይልቅ ለመናፍስት አባት አብልጠን ልንገዛና በሕይወት ልንኖር በተገባን?

verses.en: For they verily for a few days chastened us after their own pleasure; but he for our profit, that we might be partakers of his holiness.
verses.am: እነርሱ መልካም ሆኖ እንደ ታያቸው ለጥቂት ቀን ይቀጡን ነበርና፥ እርሱ ግን ከቅድስናው እንድንካፈል ለጥቅማችን ይቀጣናል።

verses.en: Now no chastening for the present seemeth to be joyous, but grievous: nevertheless afterward it yieldeth the peaceable fruit of righteousness unto them which are exercised thereby.
verses.am: ቅጣት ሁሉ ለጊዜው የሚያሳዝን እንጂ ደስ የሚያሰኝ አይመስልም፥ ዳሩ ግን በኋላ ለለመዱት የሰላምን ፍሬ እርሱም ጽድቅን ያፈራላቸዋል።

verses.en: Wherefore lift up the hands which hang down, and the feeble knees;
verses.am: ስለዚህ የላሉትን እጆች የሰለሉትንም ጉልበቶች አቅኑ፤

verses.en: And make straight paths for your feet, lest that which is lame be turned out of the way; but let it rather be healed.
verses.am: ያነከሰውም እንዲፈወስ እንጂ እንዳይናጋ፥ ለእግራችሁ ቅን መንገድ አድርጉ።

verses.en: Follow peace with all men, and holiness, without which no man shall see the Master:
verses.am: ከሰው ሁሉ ጋር ሰላምን ተከታተሉ ትቀደሱም ዘንድ ፈልጉ፥ ያለ እርሱ ጌታን ሊያይ የሚችል የለምና።

verses.en: Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of YAHUAH; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and thereby many be defiled; fail...; or, fall from
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ጸጋ ለማንም እንዳይጎድለው፥ ብዙዎቹም የሚረክሱበት አንድ መራራ ሥር ወደ ላይ በቅሎ እንዳያስጨንቅ፥ ሴሰኛም የሚሆን እንዳይገኝ፥

verses.en: Lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright.
verses.am: ወይም ስለ አንድ መብል በኵርነቱን እንደ ሸጠ እንደ ዔሳው ለዚህ ዓለም የሚመች ሰው እንዳይሆን ተጠንቀቁ።

verses.en: For ye know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected: for he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears.
verses.am: ከዚያ በኋላ እንኳ በረከቱን ሊወርስ በወደደ ጊዜ እንደ ተጣለ ታውቃላችሁና፤ በእንባ ተግቶ ምንም ቢፈልገው ለንስሐ ስፍራ አላገኘምና።

verses.en: For ye are not come unto the mount that might be touched, and that burned with fire, nor unto blackness, and darkness, and tempest,
verses.am: ሊዳሰስ ወደሚችል ወደሚቃጠልም እሳት ወደ ጭጋግም ወደ ጨለማም ወደ ዐውሎ ነፋስም ወደ መለከት ድምፅም ወደ ቃሎችም ነገር አልደረሳችሁምና፤

verses.en: And the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which voice they that heard intreated that the word should not be spoken to them any more:
verses.am: ያንም ነገር የሰሙት ሌላ ቃል እንዳይጨመርባቸው ለመኑ፤

verses.en: (For they could not endure that which was commanded, And if so much as a beast touch the mountain, it shall be stoned, or thrust through with a dart:
verses.am: እንስሳ እንኳ ተራራውን ቢነካ ተወግሮ ይሙት የምትለውን ትእዛዝ ሊታገሡ አልቻሉምና፤

verses.en: And so terrible was the sight, that Mosheh said, I exceedingly fear and quake:)
verses.am: ሙሴም። እጅግ እፈራለሁ እንቀጠቀጥማለሁ እስኪል ድረስ የሚታየው እጅግ የሚያስፈራ ነበር፤

verses.en: But ye are come unto mount Sion, and unto the city of the living YAHUAH, the heavenly Yerushalayim, and to an innumerable company of angels,
verses.am: ነገር ግን ወደ ጽዮን ተራራና ወደ ሕያው እግዚአብሔር ከተማ ደርሳችኋል፥ ወደ ሰማያዊቱም ኢየሩሳሌም፥ በደስታም ወደ ተሰበሰቡት ወደ አእላፋት መላእክት፥

verses.en: To the general assembly and assembly of the firstborn, which are written in heaven, and to YAHUAH the Judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect,
verses.am: በሰማያትም ወደ ተጻፉ ወደ በኵራት ማኅበር፥ የሁሉም ዳኛ ወደሚሆን ወደ እግዚአብሔር፥ ፍጹማንም ወደ ሆኑት ወደ ጻድቃን መንፈሶች፥

verses.en: And to Yahushua the mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling, that speaketh better things than that of Abel.
verses.am: የአዲስም ኪዳን መካከለኛ ወደሚሆን ወደ ኢየሱስ፥ ከአቤልም ደም ይልቅ የሚሻለውን ወደሚናገር ወደ መርጨት ደም ደርሳችኋል።

verses.en: See that ye refuse not him that speaketh. For if they escaped not who refused him that spake on earth, much more shall not we escape, if we turn away from him that speaketh from heaven:
verses.am: ለሚናገረው እምቢ እንዳትሉ ተጠንቀቁ፤ እነዚያ በምድር ላስረዳቸው እምቢ ባሉ ጊዜ ካላመለጡ፥ ከሰማይ ከመጣው ፈቀቅ የምንል እኛስ እንዴት እናመልጣለን?

verses.en: Whose voice then shook the earth: but now he hath promised, saying, Yet once more I shake not the earth only, but also heaven.
verses.am: በዚያም ጊዜ ድምፁ ምድርን አናወጠ፥ አሁን ግን። አንድ ጊዜ ደግሜ እኔ ሰማይን አናውጣለሁ እንጂ ምድርን ብቻ አይደለም ብሎ ተስፋ ሰጥቶአል።

verses.en: And this word, Yet once more, signifieth the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that are made, that those things which cannot be shaken may remain.
verses.am: ዳሩ ግን። አንድ ጊዜ ደግሜ የሚል ቃል፥ የማይናወጡት ጸንተው እንዲኖሩ፥ የሚናወጡት የተፈጠሩ እንደሚሆኑ ይለወጡ ዘንድ ያሳያል።

verses.en: Wherefore we receiving a kingdom which cannot be moved, let us have grace, whereby we may serve YAHUAH acceptably with reverence and godly fear:
verses.am: ስለዚህ የማይናወጥን መንግሥት ስለምንቀበል በማክበርና በፍርሃት እግዚአብሔርን ደስ እያሰኘን የምናመልክበትን ጸጋ እንያዝ፤

verses.en: For our YAHUAH is a consuming fire.
verses.am: አምላካችን በእውነት የሚያጠፋ እሳት ነውና።

verses.en: Let brotherly love continue.
verses.am: ወንድማማች መዋደድ ይኑር።

verses.en: Be not forgetful to entertain strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.
verses.am: የ እንግዶችን መቀበል አትርሱ፤ በዚህ አንዳንዶች ሳያውቁ መላእክትን እንግድነት ተቀብለዋልና።

verses.en: Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; and them which suffer adversity, as being yourselves also in the body.
verses.am: ከእነርሱ ጋር እንደ ታሰረ ሆናችሁ እስሮችን አስቡ፥ የተጨነቁትንም ራሳችሁ ደግሞ በሥጋ እንዳለ ሆናችሁ አስቡ።

verses.en: Marriage is honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers YAHUAH will judge.
verses.am: መጋባት በሁሉ ዘንድ ክቡር መኝታውም ንጹሕ ይሁን፤ ሴሰኞችንና አመንዝሮችን ግን እግዚአብሔር ይፈርድባቸዋል።

verses.en: Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.
verses.am: አካሄዳችሁ ገንዘብን ያለ መውደድ ይሁን፥ ያላችሁም ይብቃችሁ፤ እርሱ ራሱ። አልለቅህም ከቶም አልተውህም ብሎአልና፤

verses.en: So that we may boldly say, The Master is my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do unto me.
verses.am: ስለዚህ በድፍረት። ጌታ ይረዳኛልና አልፈራም፤ ሰው ምን ያደርገኛል? እንላለን።

verses.en: Remember them which have the rule over you, who have spoken unto you the word of YAHUAH: whose faith follow, considering the end of their conversation.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል የተናገሩአችሁን ዋኖቻችሁን አስቡ፥ የኑሮአቸውንም ፍሬ እየተመለከታችሁ በእምነታቸው ምሰሉአቸው።

verses.en: Yahushua the Messiah the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.
verses.am: ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ትናንትና ዛሬ እስከ ለዘላለምም ያው ነው።

verses.en: Be not carried about with divers and strange doctrines. For it is a good thing that the heart be established with grace; not with meats, which have not profited them that have been occupied therein.
verses.am: ልዩ ልዩ ዓይነት በሆነ በእንግዳ ትምህርት አትወሰዱ፤ ልባችሁ በጸጋ ቢጸና መልካም ነው እንጂ በመብል አይደለም፤ በዚህ የሚሠሩባት አልተጠቀሙምና።

verses.en: We have an altar, whereof they have no right to eat which serve the tabernacle.
verses.am: መሠዊያ አለን፥ ከእርሱም ሊበሉ ድንኳኒቱን የሚያገለግሉ መብት የላቸውም።

verses.en: For the bodies of those beasts, whose blood is brought into the sanctuary by the high priest for sin, are burned without the camp.
verses.am: ሊቀ ካህናት ስለ ኃጢአት ወደ ቅድስት የእንስሶችን ደም ያቀርባልና፤ ሥጋቸው ግን ከሰፈሩ ውጭ ይቃጠላል።

verses.en: Wherefore Yahushua also, that he might sanctify the people with his own blood, suffered without the gate.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ኢየሱስ ደግሞ በገዛ ደሙ ሕዝቡን እንዲቀድስ ከበር ውጭ መከራን ተቀበለ።

verses.en: Let us go forth therefore unto him without the camp, bearing his reproach.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ነቀፌታውን እየተሸከምን ወደ እርሱ ወደ ሰፈሩ ውጭ እንውጣ፤

verses.en: For here have we no continuing city, but we seek one to come.
verses.am: በዚህ የምትኖር ከተማ የለችንምና፥ ነገር ግን ትመጣ ዘንድ ያላትን እንፈልጋለን።

verses.en: By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to YAHUAH continually, that is, the fruit of our lips giving thanks to his name.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ዘወትር ለእግዚአብሔር የምስጋናን መሥዋዕት፥ ማለት ለስሙ የሚመሰክሩ የከንፈሮችን ፍሬ፥ በእርሱ እናቅርብለት።

verses.en: But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices YAHUAH is well pleased.
verses.am: ነገር ግን መልካም ማድረግን ለሌሎችም ማካፈልን አትርሱ፤ እንዲህ ያለው መሥዋዕት እግዚአብሔርን ደስ ያሰኘዋልና።

verses.en: Obey them that have the rule over you, and submit yourselves: for they watch for your souls, as they that must give account, that they may do it with joy, and not with grief: for that is unprofitable for you.
verses.am: ለዋኖቻችሁ ታዘዙና ተገዙ፤ እነርሱ ስሌትን እንደሚሰጡ አድርገው፥ ይህንኑ በደስታ እንጂ በኃዘን እንዳያደርጉት፥ ይህ የማይጠቅማችሁ ነበርና፥ ስለ ነፍሳችሁ ይተጋሉ።

verses.en: Pray for us: for we trust we have a good conscience, in all things willing to live honestly.
verses.am: ጸልዩልን፤ በነገር ሁሉ በመልካም እንድንኖር ወደን፥ መልካም ሕሊና እንዳለን ተረድተናልና።

verses.en: But I beseech you the rather to do this, that I may be restored to you the sooner.
verses.am: ይልቁንም ፈጥኜ እንድመለስላችሁ ይህን ታደርጉ ዘንድ አጥብቄ እለምናችኋለሁ።

verses.en: Now YAHUAH of peace, that brought again from the dead our Master Yahushua, that great shepherd of the sheep, through the blood of the everlasting covenant,
verses.am: በዘላለም ኪዳን ደም ለበጎች ትልቅ እረኛ የሆነውን ጌታችንን ኢየሱስን ከሙታን ያወጣው የሰላም አምላክ፥

verses.en: Make you perfect in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is wellpleasing in his sight, through Yahushua the Messiah; to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.am: በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ በኩል በፊቱ ደስ የሚያሰኘውን በእናንተ እያደረገ፥ ፈቃዱን ታደርጉ ዘንድ በመልካም ሥራ ሁሉ ፍጹማን ያድርጋችሁ፤ ለእርሱ እስከ ዘላለም ድረስ ክብር ይሁን፤ አሜን።

verses.en: And I beseech you, brethren, suffer the word of exhortation: for I have written a letter unto you in few words.
verses.am: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ የምክርን ቃል እንድትታገሡ እመክራችኋለሁ፥ በጥቂት ቃል ጽፌላችኋለሁና።

verses.en: Know ye that our brother Timothy is set at liberty; with whom, if he come shortly, I will see you.
verses.am: ወንድማችን ጢሞቴዎስ እንደ ተፈታ እወቁ፥ ቶሎ ብሎም ቢመጣ ከእርሱ ጋር አያችኋለሁ።

verses.en: Salute all them that have the rule over you, and all the saints. They of Italy salute you.
verses.am: ለዋኖቻችሁ ሁሉና ለቅዱሳን ሁሉ ሰላምታ አቅርቡልኝ። ከኢጣልያ የሆኑቱ ሰላምታ ያቀርቡላችኋል።

verses.en: Grace be with you all. Amen. «»
verses.am: ጸጋ ከሁላችሁ ጋር ይሁን፤ አሜን።
